# Overview

This document contains the qualitative analysis pipeline. It reads from two
pre-generated Excel files produced by `00_codificacion_api.R`:

- `resultados_codificacion_api.xlsx` — all codings (sheet: `Codificaciones`)
- `muestra_para_codificacion_humana_COMPLETADA.xlsx` — human IRR codings (sheet: `Muestra_IRR`)

**Do NOT re-run the API coding here. Use `00_codificacion_api.R` for that.**

---

# Step 0 — Packages

```{r packages}
pkgs <- c("openxlsx", "irr", "poLCA", "car", "tidyverse", "knitr", "ggplot2",
          "patchwork", "ggrepel")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(p) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly=TRUE)) install.packages(p)
}))
library(openxlsx); library(irr); library(poLCA); library(car)
library(tidyverse); library(knitr); library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork); library(ggrepel)
```

---

# Step 1 — Load Codings from Excel

```{r load-codings}
cod_all     <- read.xlsx("resultados_codificacion_api.xlsx",
                          sheet = "Codificaciones")
valid_codes <- cod_all[cod_all$error == "", ]
n_valid     <- nrow(valid_codes)

# Mutually exclusive blocks
cats_B <- c("B1","B2","B3","B4","B5","B6")
cats_L <- c("L1","L2","L3","L4","L5")
cats_E <- c("E1","E2","E3","E4","E5")
cats_D <- c("D1","D2","D3","D4")
all_cats <- c(cats_B, cats_L, cats_E, cats_D)

# E5 ("no ethical mention") is derived as the complement of E1-E4, so the
# definition is identical for model and human raters.
# Reference for residual-category handling: documented in Methods.
derive_E5 <- function(df) {
  e_present <- rowSums(df[, c("E1","E2","E3","E4")], na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  as.integer(!e_present)
}
if (all(c("E1","E2","E3","E4") %in% names(valid_codes))) {
  valid_codes$E5 <- derive_E5(valid_codes)
}

cat(sprintf("Total codings loaded:     %d\n", nrow(cod_all)))
cat(sprintf("Valid codings:            %d\n", n_valid))
cat(sprintf("Errors / insufficient:    %d\n", sum(cod_all$error != "")))
cat(sprintf("Model confidence (mean):  %.2f\n",
            mean(valid_codes$confianza, na.rm=TRUE)))
```

# Step 2 — Load Data for Quantitative Scores

```{r load-data}
datos_raw <- read.csv("data/dataframe.csv",
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      fileEncoding     = "UTF-8",
                      sep              = ";")
datos_txt <- datos_raw[datos_raw$Consentimiento %in% c("Si", "Sí"), ]
datos_txt <- datos_txt[!is.na(datos_txt$experiencia) &
                         nchar(trimws(datos_txt$experiencia)) > 10, ]
datos_txt$id_respuesta <- seq_len(nrow(datos_txt))

cat(sprintf("Rows with usable text: %d\n", nrow(datos_txt)))
```

# Step 3 — Category Frequencies

```{r frequencies}
category_labels <- list(
  B1="Writing/text structure",    B2="Synthesis/comprehension",
  B3="Problem solving",           B4="Efficiency/time saving",
  B5="Learning concepts",         B6="Other benefits",
  L1="Inaccurate information",    L2="Excessive dependence",
  L3="Lack of depth",             L4="Difficulty verifying",
  L5="Other limitations",
  E1="Plagiarism/integrity",      E2="Responsible use",
  E3="Privacy/data",              E4="Unspecified ethical reflection",
  E5="No ethical mention",
  D1="Reflective use",            D2="Instrumental use",
  D3="Limits/avoids AI",          D4="Ambivalent attitude"
)

freq_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_cats, function(cat) {
  n   <- sum(valid_codes[[cat]], na.rm=TRUE)
  pct <- round(n / n_valid * 100, 1)
  data.frame(Code=cat, Description=category_labels[[cat]],
             n=n, Percentage=paste0(pct,"%"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}))

kable(freq_table[grepl("^B", freq_table$Code), ],
      caption="BENEFITS mentioned in open responses", row.names=FALSE)
kable(freq_table[grepl("^L", freq_table$Code), ],
      caption="LIMITATIONS mentioned", row.names=FALSE)
kable(freq_table[grepl("^E", freq_table$Code), ],
      caption="ETHICAL CONSIDERATIONS mentioned (E5 derived as complement of E1-E4)",
      row.names=FALSE)
kable(freq_table[grepl("^D", freq_table$Code), ],
      caption="USAGE DECISION patterns", row.names=FALSE)
```

# Step 4 — Inter-Rater Reliability (Kappa)

```{r irr-load}
irr_human  <- read.xlsx("muestra_para_codificacion_humana_COMPLETADA.xlsx",
                         sheet = "Muestra_IRR")
irr_modelo <- read.xlsx("resultados_codificacion_api.xlsx",
                         sheet = "Muestra_IRR")

# Align by id_respuesta
ids_ok     <- intersect(irr_modelo$id_respuesta, irr_human$id_respuesta)
irr_modelo <- irr_modelo[match(ids_ok, irr_modelo$id_respuesta), ]
irr_human  <- irr_human[ match(ids_ok, irr_human$id_respuesta),  ]

# Derive E5 identically for both raters before computing kappa, so that the
# category anchoring the 86.9% "ethical paradox" has valid inter-rater support.
if (all(c("E1","E2","E3","E4") %in% names(irr_modelo))) {
  irr_modelo$E5 <- derive_E5(irr_modelo)
}
if (all(paste0("humano_", c("E1","E2","E3","E4")) %in% names(irr_human))) {
  e_present_h          <- rowSums(irr_human[, paste0("humano_", c("E1","E2","E3","E4"))],
                                  na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  irr_human$humano_E5  <- as.integer(!e_present_h)
}

cat(sprintf("IRR rows aligned: %d / %d (model) matched with %d (human)\n",
            length(ids_ok), nrow(irr_modelo), nrow(irr_human)))
cat(sprintf("id_respuesta match: %s\n",
            ifelse(all(irr_modelo$id_respuesta == irr_human$id_respuesta),
                   "PERFECT", "MISMATCH — check")))
cat(sprintf("E5 now present for human rater: %s (n_human_E5 = %d)\n",
            ifelse("humano_E5" %in% names(irr_human), "YES", "NO"),
            if ("humano_E5" %in% names(irr_human)) sum(irr_human$humano_E5, na.rm=TRUE) else NA))
```

```{r kappa}
kappa_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_cats, function(cat) {
  model_col <- as.integer(irr_modelo[[cat]])
  human_col <- irr_human[[paste0("humano_", cat)]]

  if (is.null(human_col)) {
    return(data.frame(Code=cat, Description=category_labels[[cat]],
                      Kappa=NA, Status="column_not_found",
                      n_model=sum(model_col, na.rm=TRUE), n_human=NA))
  }
  n_model <- sum(model_col, na.rm=TRUE)
  n_human <- sum(as.integer(human_col), na.rm=TRUE)

  if (var(model_col, na.rm=TRUE)==0 || var(as.numeric(human_col), na.rm=TRUE)==0) {
    status <- ifelse(n_model==0 & n_human==0,
                     "no_cases_both (trivial kappa=1)",
                     "no_variance (exclude from mean)")
    return(data.frame(Code=cat, Description=category_labels[[cat]],
                      Kappa=NA, Status=status,
                      n_model=n_model, n_human=n_human))
  }
  k <- tryCatch(
    kappa2(cbind(model_col, as.integer(human_col)))$value,
    error   = function(e) NA_real_,
    warning = function(w) suppressWarnings(
      kappa2(cbind(model_col, as.integer(human_col)))$value))

  # Landis & Koch (1977) labels — consistent with the cited cutoffs
  status <- ifelse(is.na(k), "error",
            ifelse(k>=.81,"Almost perfect",
            ifelse(k>=.61,"Substantial",
            ifelse(k>=.41,"Moderate",
            ifelse(k>=.21,"Fair","Slight")))))

  data.frame(Code=cat, Description=category_labels[[cat]],
             Kappa=round(k,3), Status=status,
             n_model=n_model, n_human=n_human)
}))

kable(kappa_results, caption="Cohen's kappa by category (Landis & Koch, 1977)",
      row.names=FALSE)

# Group means. NOTE: cats_observable / cats_interpret are a reporting choice;
# they must cover only computable categories and match what the manuscript
# describes. Categories with NA kappa are excluded from every mean by construction.
kappas_valid    <- kappa_results$Kappa[!is.na(kappa_results$Kappa)]
kappa_mean      <- mean(kappas_valid)
cats_observable <- c("B1","B3","B4","B5","L1","L2","L3","L4")
cats_interpret  <- c("B2","D1","D2","E2")   # B6 excluded (NA kappa: no variance)

k_obs <- mean(kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code %in% cats_observable], na.rm=TRUE)
k_int <- mean(kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code %in% cats_interpret],  na.rm=TRUE)

lab_band <- function(k) ifelse(is.na(k), "NA",
                        ifelse(k>=.61,"Substantial",
                        ifelse(k>=.41,"Moderate",
                        ifelse(k>=.21,"Fair","Slight"))))

group_summary <- data.frame(
  Group      = c("Observable","Interpretive","Global"),
  n_cats     = c(sum(!is.na(kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code %in% cats_observable])),
                 sum(!is.na(kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code %in% cats_interpret])),
                 length(kappas_valid)),
  Kappa_mean = round(c(k_obs, k_int, kappa_mean), 3),
  Interpretation = c(lab_band(k_obs), lab_band(k_int), lab_band(kappa_mean)))

kable(group_summary, caption="Kappa by category group", row.names=FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nMean kappa (n=%d calculable): %.3f (%s)\n",
            length(kappas_valid), kappa_mean, lab_band(kappa_mean)))
cat("Reference: Landis & Koch (1977)\n")
cat("\nReport E5 kappa explicitly in text: it underpins the 86.9% 'no ethical\n")
cat("mention' finding. Value below (if computable):\n")
e5_k <- kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code == "E5"]
cat(sprintf("  E5 kappa = %s\n", ifelse(length(e5_k) && !is.na(e5_k), sprintf("%.3f", e5_k),
                                        "NA — inspect E5 derivation")))
```

```{r pabak}
# PABAK: Prevalence-Adjusted Bias-Adjusted Kappa (Byrt, Bishop & Carlin, 1993)
filas_pabak <- list()
for (cat in all_cats) {
  model_col <- as.integer(irr_modelo[[cat]])
  human_col <- as.integer(irr_human[[paste0("humano_", cat)]])
  if (is.null(human_col) || length(model_col) != length(human_col)) next
  ok <- !is.na(model_col) & !is.na(human_col)
  if (sum(ok) == 0) next
  mc <- model_col[ok]; hc <- human_col[ok]
  Po    <- mean(mc == hc)
  PABAK <- 2*Po - 1
  k_val <- kappa_results$Kappa[kappa_results$Code == cat]
  k_val <- if (length(k_val)>0 && !is.na(k_val[1])) k_val[1] else NA_real_
  filas_pabak[[length(filas_pabak)+1]] <- data.frame(
    Code=cat, Prevalence=round(mean(mc),3),
    Po_agree=round(Po,3), PABAK=round(PABAK,3),
    Kappa=round(k_val,3),
    Delta=round(PABAK - ifelse(is.na(k_val),0,k_val), 3),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
pabak_df        <- do.call(rbind, filas_pabak)
pabak_df$Delta  <- as.numeric(pabak_df$Delta)
pabak_df        <- pabak_df[order(-abs(pabak_df$Delta), na.last=TRUE), ]
kable(pabak_df,
      caption="PABAK vs simple kappa (delta > .10 = kappa underestimation)",
      row.names=FALSE)
cat("\nNote: report PABAK for categories with prevalence < .15 or > .85\n")
cat("Reference: Byrt et al. (1993)\n")
```

# Step 5 — Connection with Quantitative Scores

```{r quant-connection}
items_knowledge   <- paste0("IA.C", sprintf("%02d", 1:13))
items_ethics      <- c(paste0("IA.E", sprintf("%02d", 1:10)), "IA.E13","IA.E14")
items_attitude    <- paste0("IA.A", sprintf("%02d", c(1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12)))
items_application <- c(paste0("IA.P", sprintf("%02d", 2:6)),
                       paste0("IA.P", sprintf("%02d", 8:16)))
items_innovation  <- c("IA.I01","IA.I03","IA.I04")
all_items         <- c(items_knowledge, items_ethics, items_attitude,
                       items_application, items_innovation)

items_found <- intersect(all_items, names(datos_txt))
cat(sprintf("Scale items found: %d / %d\n", length(items_found), length(all_items)))

if (length(items_found) > 40) {
  datos_txt[items_found] <- lapply(datos_txt[items_found], as.numeric)
  datos_txt$Score_Knowledge   <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, intersect(items_knowledge,   items_found)], na.rm=TRUE)
  datos_txt$Score_Ethics      <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, intersect(items_ethics,      items_found)], na.rm=TRUE)
  datos_txt$Score_Attitude    <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, intersect(items_attitude,    items_found)], na.rm=TRUE)
  datos_txt$Score_Application <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, intersect(items_application, items_found)], na.rm=TRUE)
  datos_txt$Score_Innovation  <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, intersect(items_innovation,  items_found)], na.rm=TRUE)
  datos_txt$Score_Total       <- rowMeans(datos_txt[, items_found], na.rm=TRUE)

  score_cols   <- c("id_respuesta","Score_Knowledge","Score_Ethics","Score_Attitude",
                    "Score_Application","Score_Innovation","Score_Total")
  coded_scores <- merge(valid_codes, datos_txt[, score_cols],
                        by="id_respuesta", all.x=TRUE)

  cat(sprintf("Responses with scores: %d\n\n", sum(!is.na(coded_scores$Score_Total))))

  n_d1 <- sum(coded_scores$D1==1, na.rm=TRUE)
  n_d2 <- sum(coded_scores$D2==1, na.rm=TRUE)

  if (n_d1>5 && n_d2>5) {
    t_res   <- t.test(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D1==1],
                      coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D2==1])
    sd_pool <- sqrt(((n_d1-1)*var(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D1==1],na.rm=TRUE)+
                     (n_d2-1)*var(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D2==1],na.rm=TRUE))/
                    (n_d1+n_d2-2))
    d_cohen <- (mean(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D1==1],na.rm=TRUE)-
                mean(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D2==1],na.rm=TRUE))/sd_pool

    print(kable(data.frame(Group=c("D1 — Reflective","D2 — Instrumental"),
                     n=c(n_d1,n_d2),
                     M_Total=round(c(mean(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D1==1],na.rm=TRUE),
                                     mean(coded_scores$Score_Total[coded_scores$D2==1],na.rm=TRUE)),2)),
          caption="Scores by usage type", row.names=FALSE))

    # Welch t-test is the default of t.test(); label it as such.
    cat(sprintf("\nWelch t(%.0f) = %.2f, p = %.3f | Cohen's d = %.3f (%s)\n",
                t_res$parameter, t_res$statistic, t_res$p.value, d_cohen,
                ifelse(abs(d_cohen)>=.80,"large",ifelse(abs(d_cohen)>=.50,"medium","small"))))

    dim_scores <- c("Score_Knowledge","Score_Ethics","Score_Attitude",
                    "Score_Application","Score_Innovation")
    print(kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(dim_scores, function(d)
      data.frame(Dimension=gsub("Score_","",d),
                 M_D1=round(mean(coded_scores[[d]][coded_scores$D1==1],na.rm=TRUE),2),
                 M_D2=round(mean(coded_scores[[d]][coded_scores$D2==1],na.rm=TRUE),2),
                 Delta=round(mean(coded_scores[[d]][coded_scores$D1==1],na.rm=TRUE)-
                             mean(coded_scores[[d]][coded_scores$D2==1],na.rm=TRUE),2)))),
          caption="Scores by dimension — D1 vs D2", row.names=FALSE))
  }
}
```

# Step 6 — Extended Convergent Validity

```{r convergent-extended}
coded_scores$n_words      <- sapply(strsplit(trimws(coded_scores$texto),"\\s+"), length)
coded_scores$n_categories <- rowSums(coded_scores[, all_cats], na.rm=TRUE)

ct_len <- cor.test(coded_scores$n_words, coded_scores$Score_Total)
ct_inn <- cor.test(coded_scores$n_words, coded_scores$Score_Innovation)
cat(sprintf("n_words x Score_Total:      r = %+.3f, p = %.3f\n",
            ct_len$estimate, ct_len$p.value))
cat(sprintf("n_words x Score_Innovation: r = %+.3f, p = %.3f\n\n",
            ct_inn$estimate, ct_inn$p.value))

pairs_to_test <- list(
  c("B1","Score_Application","Writing x Application"),
  c("B2","Score_Knowledge",  "Synthesis x Knowledge"),
  c("B5","Score_Knowledge",  "Learning x Knowledge"),
  c("D1","Score_Innovation", "Reflective x Innovation"),
  c("D1","Score_Ethics",     "Reflective x Ethics"),
  c("E1","Score_Ethics",     "Plagiarism x Ethics"),
  c("E2","Score_Ethics",     "Responsible x Ethics"),
  c("L2","Score_Application","Dependency x Application")
)

filas_conv <- lapply(pairs_to_test, function(p) {
  if (!(p[1] %in% names(coded_scores)) || !(p[2] %in% names(coded_scores)))
    return(NULL)
  x_bin <- as.integer(coded_scores[[p[1]]])
  y_cont<- coded_scores[[p[2]]]
  prev  <- mean(x_bin, na.rm=TRUE)
  ct    <- cor.test(x_bin, y_cont)
  r_pb  <- ct$estimate
  phi_z <- dnorm(qnorm(prev))
  r_bis <- ifelse(phi_z>0, r_pb*sqrt(prev*(1-prev))/phi_z, NA)
  data.frame(Pair=p[3], Qualitative=p[1], Quantitative=gsub("Score_","",p[2]),
             Prevalence=round(prev,3), r_pb=round(r_pb,3),
             r_bis=round(r_bis,3), p_raw=ct$p.value)
})
conv_results        <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), filas_conv))
conv_results$p_FDR  <- round(p.adjust(conv_results$p_raw, method="BH"), 3)
conv_results$p_raw  <- round(conv_results$p_raw, 3)
conv_results$Sig    <- ifelse(conv_results$p_FDR < .05, "*", "")

kable(conv_results,
      caption=sprintf("Point-biserial correlations with FDR correction (%d comparisons)",
                      nrow(conv_results)),
      row.names=FALSE)
cat("\n* Significant after FDR (alpha = .05)\n")
cat(sprintf("FDR family size (this step) = %d (extended convergent validity).\n",
            nrow(conv_results)))
cat("Triangulation (Step 9) uses its own FDR family of 5 comparisons (the five\n")
cat("dimensions); this extended convergent validity uses a separate family of 8.\n")
cat("The manuscript reports the family of 5 (Table 4).\n")
```

---

# Step 7 — Sociodemographic Differences

```{r sociodemographic}
socio_cols   <- intersect(c("id_respuesta","Sexo","Clasificacion"), names(datos_txt))
coded_socio  <- merge(coded_scores, datos_txt[, socio_cols],
                      by="id_respuesta", all.x=TRUE)

# ---- 7a. Usage type by sex (Fisher) --------------------------------------
if ("Sexo" %in% names(coded_socio)) {
  valid_grp  <- names(table(coded_socio$Sexo))[table(coded_socio$Sexo)>=10]
  coded_sex  <- coded_socio[coded_socio$Sexo %in% valid_grp, ]
  tab_sex    <- table(
    Usage = ifelse(coded_sex$D1==1,"Reflective",
            ifelse(coded_sex$D2==1,"Instrumental","Other/Mixed")),
    Sex   = coded_sex$Sexo)
  print(kable(as.data.frame.matrix(tab_sex),
        caption="Usage type by sex (absolute frequencies)"))
  print(kable(round(prop.table(tab_sex, margin=2)*100,1),
        caption="Usage type by sex (column %)"))
  set.seed(2024)
  fisher_res <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tab_sex,simulate.p.value=TRUE,B=10000),
                         error=function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fisher_res)) {
    cat(sprintf("\nFisher exact (B=10,000): p = %.3f\n", fisher_res$p.value))
    cat(sprintf("Conclusion to report: usage type %s by sex.\n",
                ifelse(fisher_res$p.value < .05,
                       "DIFFERS significantly", "does NOT differ significantly")))
    cat("Do NOT tie this result to measurement invariance (separate analysis).\n")
  }
}

# ---- 7b. Ethics-MENTION frequency by study area (proportion test) --------
# This is a frequency analysis (proportion of E1/E2 mentions), distinct from
# the score-based ANOVA in 7c.
if ("Clasificacion" %in% names(coded_socio)) {
  coded_socio$mentions_ethics <- as.integer(coded_socio$E1==1 | coded_socio$E2==1)
  eth_area <- data.frame(
    Area = names(tapply(coded_socio$mentions_ethics, coded_socio$Clasificacion, mean, na.rm=TRUE)),
    Pct  = round(tapply(coded_socio$mentions_ethics, coded_socio$Clasificacion, mean, na.rm=TRUE)*100,1),
    n    = as.integer(tapply(coded_socio$mentions_ethics, coded_socio$Clasificacion, length)))
  print(kable(eth_area[order(-eth_area$Pct),], row.names=FALSE,
        caption="Ethics mention (E1+E2) frequency by study area"))

  # Global test of independence between ethics mention and area (frequencies)
  tab_eth_area <- table(coded_socio$mentions_ethics, coded_socio$Clasificacion)
  chisq_eth <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab_eth_area)), error=function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(chisq_eth)) {
    set.seed(2024)
    fish_eth <- fisher.test(tab_eth_area, simulate.p.value=TRUE, B=10000)
    cat(sprintf("\nEthics-mention frequency x area: chi2(%d) = %.2f, p = %.3f; ",
                chisq_eth$parameter, chisq_eth$statistic, chisq_eth$p.value))
    cat(sprintf("Fisher (B=10,000) p = %.3f\n", fish_eth$p.value))
    cat("Report this as the frequency analysis (e.g., 14.2%% vs 3.0%% across areas).\n")
  }

  # ---- 7c. Ethics SCORE by area (ANOVA / Welch + effect size) ------------
  if ("Score_Ethics" %in% names(coded_socio)) {
    lev <- tryCatch(car::leveneTest(Score_Ethics~factor(Clasificacion),data=coded_socio),
                    error=function(e) NULL)
    lev_ok <- if (!is.null(lev)) lev[1,"Pr(>F)"]>=.05 else TRUE
    cat(sprintf("\nLevene: p = %.3f -> %s\n", if(!is.null(lev)) lev[1,"Pr(>F)"] else NA,
                ifelse(lev_ok,"homogeneous (ANOVA)","heterogeneous (Welch)")))

    if (lev_ok) {
      aov_res <- aov(Score_Ethics~Clasificacion, data=coded_socio)
      aov_s   <- summary(aov_res)[[1]]
      eta2    <- round(aov_s[1,"Sum Sq"]/sum(aov_s[,"Sum Sq"]),3)
      cat(sprintf("ANOVA (scores): F(%.0f,%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f, eta2=%.3f\n",
                  aov_s[1,"Df"],aov_s[2,"Df"],aov_s[1,"F value"],aov_s[1,"Pr(>F)"],eta2))
      tuk <- as.data.frame(TukeyHSD(aov_res)$Clasificacion)
      sig <- tuk[tuk[["p adj"]]<.05,,drop=FALSE]
      if (nrow(sig)>0) { cat("Tukey significant pairs:\n"); print(round(sig,3)) }
      else cat("No significant pairs after Tukey.\n")
    } else {
      w <- oneway.test(Score_Ethics~Clasificacion,data=coded_socio,var.equal=FALSE)
      # Effect size for Welch ANOVA: omega-squared (Field, 2013).
      df_b <- as.integer(round(w$parameter[1]))
      cs   <- coded_socio[!is.na(coded_socio$Score_Ethics) &
                            !is.na(coded_socio$Clasificacion), ]
      grand <- mean(cs$Score_Ethics)
      ss_b  <- sum(tapply(cs$Score_Ethics, cs$Clasificacion,
                          function(x) length(x)*(mean(x)-grand)^2))
      ss_w  <- sum(tapply(cs$Score_Ethics, cs$Clasificacion,
                          function(x) sum((x-mean(x))^2)))
      ss_t  <- ss_b + ss_w
      ms_w  <- ss_w / (nrow(cs) - length(unique(cs$Clasificacion)))
      omega2 <- round((ss_b - df_b*ms_w) / (ss_t + ms_w), 3)
      cat(sprintf("Welch ANOVA (scores): F(%.1f,%.1f)=%.2f, p=%.3f, omega2=%.3f\n",
                  w$parameter[1], w$parameter[2], w$statistic, w$p.value, omega2))
      cat("omega2 is the reported effect size (robust to unequal n/variance).\n")
      games <- tryCatch({
        if (requireNamespace("rstatix", quietly=TRUE))
          rstatix::games_howell_test(cs, Score_Ethics ~ Clasificacion)
        else NULL
      }, error=function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(games)) {
        cat("Games-Howell post hoc (significant pairs):\n")
        gh <- as.data.frame(games)
        print(gh[gh$p.adj < .05, c("group1","group2","estimate","p.adj")])
      } else {
        cat("Install 'rstatix' for Games-Howell post hoc (appropriate under Welch).\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# Step 8 — Latent Class Analysis

```{r lca}
# Indicator-selection rule, explicit and reproducible:
#  (a) drop mutually-exclusive residual/near-zero categories that destabilize LCA
#      (B6, L5, E3, E4 have prevalence < 2% and no discriminating power);
#  (b) keep the substantive benefit/limitation/ethics/decision indicators.
# B3 and B5 are NOT dropped for "extreme prevalence" (that justification was wrong);
# they are excluded only because they did not discriminate across preliminary classes.
# To make the choice auditable, we report prevalences of all candidates first.
prev_all <- sapply(all_cats, function(c) round(mean(valid_codes[[c]], na.rm=TRUE), 3))
print(kable(data.frame(Code=names(prev_all), Prevalence=as.numeric(prev_all)),
            caption="Prevalence of all candidate indicators (for LCA selection)",
            row.names=FALSE))

lca_cats <- intersect(c("B1","B2","B4","L1","L2","E1","E2","E5",
                         "D1","D2","D3","D4"), names(coded_scores))
cat(sprintf("\nLCA indicators used (%d): %s\n", length(lca_cats),
            paste(lca_cats, collapse=", ")))
cat("Excluded (prevalence < .02 or non-discriminating): ",
    paste(setdiff(all_cats, lca_cats), collapse=", "), "\n\n")

lca_data <- coded_scores[, lca_cats]
lca_data[] <- lapply(lca_data, function(x) as.integer(x)+1L)
lca_data   <- lca_data[complete.cases(lca_data), ]

cat(sprintf("LCA: %d obs, %d indicators\n\n", nrow(lca_data), ncol(lca_data)))

formula_lca <- as.formula(paste("cbind(", paste(lca_cats, collapse=","), ") ~ 1"))

# Scan 2..5 classes so the 4-class choice is defensible.
set.seed(2024)
kmax <- 5
fit_stats <- data.frame(N_classes=integer(0), BIC=numeric(0), AIC=numeric(0),
                        Entropy=numeric(0), min_class_pct=numeric(0))
lca_models <- list()

entropy_R2 <- function(m) {
  pp <- m$posterior
  1 - (-sum(apply(pp,1,function(p) sum(p[p>0]*log(p[p>0]))))) / (nrow(pp)*log(ncol(pp)))
}

for (k in 2:kmax) {
  cat(sprintf("Estimating %d-class model...\n", k))
  m <- tryCatch(poLCA(formula_lca, data=lca_data, nclass=k, maxiter=1000,
                      nrep=20, verbose=FALSE, graphs=FALSE), error=function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(m)) {
    lca_models[[as.character(k)]] <- m
    fit_stats <- rbind(fit_stats, data.frame(
      N_classes = k,
      BIC = round(m$bic,1), AIC = round(m$aic,1),
      Entropy = round(entropy_R2(m),3),
      min_class_pct = round(min(m$P)*100,1)))
  }
}

print(kable(fit_stats,
      caption="LCA model comparison (2-5 classes): BIC, AIC, entropy, smallest class %",
      row.names=FALSE))

best_k   <- fit_stats$N_classes[which.min(fit_stats$BIC)]
best_mod <- lca_models[[as.character(best_k)]]
cat(sprintf("\nBest by BIC: %d classes. If a larger k wins on BIC but yields a\n",
            best_k))
cat("class < 5%% of the sample, prefer the more parsimonious, interpretable solution\n")
cat("and state this in Methods (Nylund et al., 2007; Weller et al., 2020).\n\n")

if (!is.null(best_mod)) {
  ent <- entropy_R2(best_mod)
  cat(sprintf("Selected: %d classes (BIC=%.1f) | Entropy=%.3f %s\n\n",
              best_k, min(fit_stats$BIC), ent,
              ifelse(ent>=.80,"(good)","(moderate — report with caution)")))

  lca_data$modal_class <- apply(best_mod$posterior, 1, which.max)

  # Class sizes from modal assignment (counts + %), not mixing proportions.
  modal_tab <- table(lca_data$modal_class)
  class_sizes_df <- data.frame(
    Class = as.integer(names(modal_tab)),
    n     = as.integer(modal_tab),
    Pct   = round(as.numeric(modal_tab)/sum(modal_tab)*100, 1))
  print(kable(class_sizes_df,
        caption="LCA class sizes (modal assignment) — USE THESE n and % everywhere",
        row.names=FALSE))
  cat(sprintf("Percentages sum to %.1f%% (modal). Smallest class = %.1f%% (n=%d).\n",
              sum(class_sizes_df$Pct),
              min(class_sizes_df$Pct),
              class_sizes_df$n[which.min(class_sizes_df$Pct)]))
  cat("poLCA class numbers are arbitrary across runs — identify each profile\n")
  cat("by its conditional-probability signature, not by its number (see Figure 3).\n\n")

  probs_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(best_mod$probs), function(j)
    data.frame(Category=lca_cats[j], t(round(best_mod$probs[[j]][,2],2)))))
  names(probs_df)[-1] <- paste0("Class_",1:best_k)
  print(kable(probs_df, caption="Conditional probabilities P(cat=1|class)", row.names=FALSE))

  coded_scores$lca_class <- NA_integer_
  coded_scores$lca_class[as.integer(rownames(lca_data))] <- lca_data$modal_class

  score_dims <- c("Score_Total","Score_Knowledge","Score_Ethics",
                  "Score_Attitude","Score_Application","Score_Innovation")
  scores_class <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(lca_data$modal_class)), function(k) {
    row <- data.frame(Class=k)
    for (d in score_dims)
      row[[gsub("Score_","",d)]] <- round(mean(coded_scores[[d]][coded_scores$lca_class==k],na.rm=TRUE),2)
    row$n <- sum(coded_scores$lca_class==k, na.rm=TRUE)
    row
  }))
  print(kable(scores_class, caption="AI Literacy scores by LCA class", row.names=FALSE))

  # Omnibus test of score differences across profiles,
  # never tested). Welch ANOVA on Score_Total + omega2.
  cs_lca <- coded_scores[!is.na(coded_scores$lca_class), ]
  cs_lca_f <- factor(cs_lca$lca_class)
  if (nlevels(cs_lca_f) >= 2) {
    w_lca <- oneway.test(Score_Total ~ cs_lca_f, data=cs_lca, var.equal=FALSE)
    grand <- mean(cs_lca$Score_Total, na.rm=TRUE)
    ss_b  <- sum(tapply(cs_lca$Score_Total, cs_lca_f, function(x) length(x)*(mean(x)-grand)^2))
    ss_w  <- sum(tapply(cs_lca$Score_Total, cs_lca_f, function(x) sum((x-mean(x))^2)))
    df_b  <- nlevels(cs_lca_f) - 1
    ms_w  <- ss_w / (nrow(cs_lca) - nlevels(cs_lca_f))
    omega2_lca <- round((ss_b - df_b*ms_w)/((ss_b+ss_w) + ms_w), 3)
    cat(sprintf("\nScore_Total across %d profiles: Welch F(%.1f, %.1f) = %.2f, p = %.3f, omega2 = %.3f\n",
                best_k, w_lca$parameter[1], w_lca$parameter[2],
                w_lca$statistic, w_lca$p.value, omega2_lca))
    cat("Report this omnibus test before describing the profile ordering.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r figura-lca, fig.width=14, fig.height=12, dpi=300}
# Figure 3 reads dynamically from the fitted model:
#  - Panel B scores from `scores_class`
#  - Panel A probabilities from `best_mod$probs`
#  - class sizes/labels from modal assignment
# All values (class percentages, BIC, entropy) are read from the fitted objects.

stopifnot(exists("scores_class"), exists("best_mod"), exists("class_sizes_df"))

# Assign profile labels by content, not by class number.
# poLCA orders classes arbitrarily across runs, so a fixed 1->label map is not
# reliable. We derive each class's label from its conditional-probability
# signature on the decision/ethics block. Definitions:
#   reflective-ethical    : high D1 (reflective) AND high E2 (responsible use)
#   reflective-pragmatic  : high D1 (reflective) AND E5 dominant (no explicit ethics)
#   instrumental-silent   : high D2 (instrumental) AND E5 dominant
#   critical-limiting     : elevated D3/D4 (limits/ambivalent) and/or L1
# If your substantive taxonomy differs, edit ONLY this scoring function.
prob_at <- function(cat, k) {
  j <- which(lca_cats == cat)
  if (length(j) == 0) return(0)
  best_mod$probs[[j]][k, 2]
}
label_class <- function(k) {
  d1 <- prob_at("D1", k); d2 <- prob_at("D2", k)
  d3 <- prob_at("D3", k); d4 <- prob_at("D4", k)
  e2 <- prob_at("E2", k); e5 <- prob_at("E5", k)
  if (d3 + d4 >= 0.40)                 return("Critical-limiting")
  if (d1 >= 0.50 && e2 >= 0.50)        return("Reflective-ethical")
  if (d1 >= 0.50)                      return("Reflective-pragmatic")
  if (d2 >= 0.50)                      return("Instrumental-silent")
  return(sprintf("Profile %d", k))     # fallback: never silently mislabel
}
prof_label <- setNames(vapply(seq_len(best_k), label_class, character(1)),
                       as.character(seq_len(best_k)))

# Guard: if two classes resolve to the same label, stop — the taxonomy needs
# a manual decision rather than a silently wrong figure.
if (anyDuplicated(prof_label)) {
  warning("Duplicate profile labels from auto-assignment: ",
          paste(sprintf("%s=%s", names(prof_label), prof_label), collapse="; "),
          ". Inspect the conditional-probability table and adjust label_class().")
}
cat("Auto-assigned profile labels (class number -> label):\n")
print(prof_label)
cat("\nVerify against the conditional-probability table above before using Figure 3.\n\n")

cls <- class_sizes_df
cls$base  <- prof_label[as.character(cls$Class)]
cls$full  <- sprintf("%s\n(n=%d, %.1f%%)", cls$base, cls$n, cls$Pct)
lvl_full  <- cls$full[order(cls$Class)]

# ---- Panel B data (dynamic) ----
dims_labels <- c(Knowledge="Knowledge", Ethics="Ethics", Attitude="Attitude",
             Application="Application", Innovation="Innovation")
panelB <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(scores_class)), function(i) {

    M = as.numeric(scores_class[i, c("Knowledge","Ethics","Attitude","Application","Innovation")]),
    n_class = scores_class$n[i],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
panelB$SE    <- 0.85 / sqrt(panelB$n_class)
panelB$Class <- factor(panelB$Class, levels = lvl_full)
panelB$Dimension <- factor(panelB$Dimension,

                 D1="D1 — Reflective use",  D2="D2 — Instrumental use",

probs_mat <- sapply(disc_cats, function(c) {

panelA <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(best_k), function(k) {

classA_levels    <- sprintf("Clase %d\n%s", sort(unique(panelA$ClassNum)),
```

# Step 8 b

```{r adicional}
# =====================================================================
# LCA SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — removing local dependence in the decision block
# D1-D4 are mutually exclusive -> they violate local independence and inflate
# entropy. Remedy (Masyn, 2013): recode the block as ONE polytomous variable
# (preserves the information) and check that the 4 profiles replicate under a
# non-deterministic specification.
# =====================================================================

# 1. Non-deterministic indicators + polytomous Decision (1..5)
#    1=reflective 2=instrumental 3=limits 4=ambivalent 5=none
sens_base <- coded_scores[, lca_cats]
sens_base <- sens_base[complete.cases(sens_base), ]
sens_base$Decision <- with(sens_base, ifelse(D1==1,1L, ifelse(D2==1,2L,
                            ifelse(D3==1,3L, ifelse(D4==1,4L, 5L)))))

keep_bin <- setdiff(lca_cats, c("D1","D2","D3","D4"))   # remaining binary indicators
sens_data <- sens_base[, c(keep_bin, "Decision")]
sens_data[keep_bin] <- lapply(sens_data[keep_bin], function(x) as.integer(x)+1L)
# Decision is already coded 1..5 (poLCA format)

cat("Distribution of Decision (polytomous):\n"); print(table(sens_data$Decision))
cat(sprintf("\nIndicators in the sensitivity model (%d): %s + Decision\n\n",
            length(keep_bin)+1, paste(keep_bin, collapse=", ")))

# 2. Refit 2..5 classes with the SAME settings as the main model
f_sens <- as.formula(paste("cbind(", paste(c(keep_bin,"Decision"), collapse=","), ") ~ 1"))
set.seed(2024)
sens_models <- list(); sens_fit <- data.frame()
for (k in 2:5) {
  m <- tryCatch(poLCA(f_sens, data=sens_data, nclass=k, maxiter=1000,
                      nrep=20, verbose=FALSE, graphs=FALSE), error=function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(m)) {
    sens_models[[as.character(k)]] <- m
    sens_fit <- rbind(sens_fit, data.frame(
      N_classes=k, BIC=round(m$bic,1), AIC=round(m$aic,1),
      Entropy=round(entropy_R2(m),3), min_class_pct=round(min(m$P)*100,1)))
  }
}
print(kable(sens_fit,
      caption="Sensitivity LCA (recoded decision block): 2-5 class comparison",
      row.names=FALSE))

best_k_sens <- sens_fit$N_classes[which.min(sens_fit$BIC)]
best_sens   <- sens_models[[as.character(best_k_sens)]]
cat(sprintf("\nBIC-optimal (sensitivity): %d classes | entropy = %.3f\n",
            best_k_sens, sens_fit$Entropy[sens_fit$N_classes==best_k_sens]))

# 3. Agreement with the main solution (modal class)
modal_sens <- apply(best_sens$posterior, 1, which.max)
modal_main <- apply(best_mod$posterior, 1, which.max)
if (length(modal_sens) == length(modal_main)) {
  cat("\nCross-tabulation: main vs sensitivity (modal class)\n")
  print(table(Main=modal_main, Sensitivity=modal_sens))
  if (requireNamespace("mclust", quietly=TRUE))
    cat(sprintf("\nAdjusted Rand index (partition agreement): %.3f\n",
                mclust::adjustedRandIndex(modal_main, modal_sens)))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\n[warning] different n (main=%d, sensitivity=%d): complete.cases\n",
              length(modal_main), length(modal_sens)))
  cat("differs because Decision uses a recoding; compare profiles by\n")
  cat("probability signature, not case by case.\n")
}

# 4. Conditional probabilities — do the profiles reappear?
cat("\nProbabilities P(cat=1|class) — binary indicators; for Decision, P(level|class):\n")
print(lapply(best_sens$probs, function(m) round(m, 2)))
```

# Step 9 — Triangulation

```{r triangulation}
# Triangulation corrects FDR over its own family of 5 comparisons (the
# five dimensions). It is independent of the family of 8 from Step 6.

tri_dims <- list(
  list(dim="Knowledge",   score="Score_Knowledge",   qual="B2"),
  list(dim="Ethics",      score="Score_Ethics",       qual="D1"),
  list(dim="Attitude",    score="Score_Attitude",     qual="D1"),
  list(dim="Application", score="Score_Application",  qual="B1"),
  list(dim="Innovation",  score="Score_Innovation",   qual="D1")
)

tri_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tri_dims, function(d) {
  fr  <- freq_table[freq_table$Code==d$qual, ]
  pct <- if (nrow(fr)>0) fr$Percentage[1] else "N/A"
  ct  <- cor.test(coded_scores[[d$qual]], coded_scores[[d$score]])
  data.frame(
    Dimension     = d$dim,
    Indicator     = d$qual,
    Pct_qual      = pct,
    M_score       = paste0(round(mean(coded_scores[[d$score]],na.rm=TRUE),2),
                           " (SD=", round(sd(coded_scores[[d$score]],na.rm=TRUE),2),")"),
    r             = round(ct$estimate,3),
    p_raw         = ct$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# FDR over the triangulation family itself, reported transparently
tri_table$p_FDR <- round(p.adjust(tri_table$p_raw, method="BH"), 3)
tri_table$p_raw <- round(tri_table$p_raw, 3)
tri_table$Convergence <- ifelse(tri_table$p_FDR < .05 & tri_table$r > 0,
                                "Converge", "Not significant")

kable(tri_table,
      caption="Mixed-methods triangulation (FDR-corrected within family)",
      row.names=FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nConvergence: %d / %d dimensions (FDR-corrected)\n",
            sum(tri_table$Convergence=="Converge"), nrow(tri_table)))
cat("\nNarrative consequence for the manuscript:\n")
cat("- Ethics converges with the qualitative signal via REFLECTIVE USE (D1),\n")
cat("  not via explicit ethical mention (E1/E2 are rare: the 'ethical paradox').\n")
cat("- The convergence count and which dimensions converge come from this table.\n")
```

# Step 10 — Export

```{r export}
wb_out <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb_out, "Frequencies");     writeData(wb_out, "Frequencies",    freq_table)
addWorksheet(wb_out, "Kappa");           writeData(wb_out, "Kappa",          kappa_results)
addWorksheet(wb_out, "Kappa_groups");    writeData(wb_out, "Kappa_groups",   group_summary)
addWorksheet(wb_out, "PABAK");           writeData(wb_out, "PABAK",          pabak_df)
addWorksheet(wb_out, "Triangulation");   writeData(wb_out, "Triangulation",  tri_table)

if (exists("conv_results"))  { addWorksheet(wb_out, "Convergent");   writeData(wb_out, "Convergent",   conv_results) }
if (exists("fit_stats"))     { addWorksheet(wb_out, "LCA_fit");      writeData(wb_out, "LCA_fit",      fit_stats) }
if (exists("class_sizes_df")){ addWorksheet(wb_out, "LCA_sizes");    writeData(wb_out, "LCA_sizes",    class_sizes_df) }
if (exists("scores_class"))  { addWorksheet(wb_out, "LCA_Profiles"); writeData(wb_out, "LCA_Profiles", scores_class) }
if (exists("eth_area"))      { addWorksheet(wb_out, "Ethics_by_area");writeData(wb_out, "Ethics_by_area", eth_area) }
if (exists("coded_scores"))  { addWorksheet(wb_out, "Coded_Scores"); writeData(wb_out, "Coded_Scores", coded_scores) }

saveWorkbook(wb_out, "resultados_analisis_cualitativo.xlsx", overwrite=TRUE)
cat("Exported: resultados_analisis_cualitativo.xlsx\n")
```
